parameters.content: Starting with Node 1 it is a scheduled trigger when it is midnight the workflow will be executed to send the daily summry for the [MAIN] workflow which is Expense Tracker.

Then Node 2 will read the data in google sheet, then send it to the filter which is Node 3 if the date is true for today*, then procced to Node 4 whoch will calculate total amount,number of transactions,totals by category, and largest expense then goes to the last Node 5 which will send the data for the user (me*) and alerts me about the data every day at midnight.
